full_page.content:
1953, July 26 Page Two
Mr. Patrick Casey
Page 2
I am trying to get time to, vinda wake them up to renewed appreciation of the only science that in the end amounts to more that the snap of one's finger, Religion; The Science of our happy dependence on Almighty God and our neighbor. What a real vestibule to Heaven this world would be if everyone would just be convinced and try to live according to that simple definition! Fr. E'd was here with us a whole week in May. A letter from him in White Plains Y. He seems to keep well most of the time. Deo Gr. God bless you again. Keep well.
Sincerely - Your Brother (B.F.) Fr. Solanus
